scope: Independent slam-earned hard shield and unchanged kick-earned soft shield. No opponent-identity condition.
genericThreshold: Both shipped leech and crumble handlers reject when bullet power <= active shield strength, before the later ordinary capacity absorption. Capacity alone does not provide this immunity.
counterBoundaries: kick preserves the hard shield without extending it
new slam does not delete the kick shield
threshold equality blocks both generic effects
power above threshold retains both effects
spent hard capacity immediately exposes the soft strength
battleConclusion: Pending the complete R11 pilot and final selected matrix; source rules and fixture checks do not establish the final match-up strength.
